title: Transportation Change Checklist
subtitle: Capture student route, effective day, alternate stop, and request source; confirm driver notice and arrival confirmation.
description: Transportation Change records student route, effective day, alternate stop, request source, driver notice, and arrival confirmation. Transportation Change evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this transportation change stage-gated verification when staff must document student route and effective day. Reconcile alternate stop, request source, driver notice, and arrival confirmation before the transportation change handoff. Use the guardian request, identity verification, original route sheet, alternate-stop map, school approval, dispatch notice, driver acknowledgment, and arrival confirmation. This request alters one student's day-specific dismissal route using guardian authentication, alternate stop or pickup person, dispatch update, driver read-back, school release, and arrival verification. Ask the assigned transportation change reviewer to confirm student route against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Transportation Change starting details review
sections.guidance: Identify student, original route, effective day, alternate stop or pickup person, request source, school approval, driver notice, and arrival confirmation.

sections.title: Transportation Change checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current transportation change facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Transportation Change required checks
items: Student route is identified for this record
Effective day matches the current request or source
Alternate stop is ready for point-of-use staff
Request source limits or questions are resolved
Driver notice is communicated to the responsible person
Arrival confirmation is confirmed at handoff
A changed transportation change fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Transportation Change failed or pending items

sections.title: Transportation Change readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold transportation change readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Transportation Change reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Transportation Change receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
